title: MotionSkillEvals
description: Checks motion scope routing, research/spec handoff, and implementation ownership.

evals.name: full-motion-preflow
evals.prompt: Add a motion system to an animation-heavy product with complex transitions, scroll choreography, and accessibility requirements.
evals.expected_output: Full motion research is completed, the motion spec is produced, and an explicit handoff is created for /develop without implementing runtime code inside /motion.
expectations: @researcher owns the merged motion-research.md after both research tracks complete
@product-designer produces motion-spec.md with complete MO-### prompts and UX researcher accessibility sign-off
@tech-lead produces motion-handoff.md and adds tasks to execution-plan.md
/motion does not claim implementation or runtime QA completion
The handoff includes reduced-motion, keyboard/focus, non-motion-equivalent, pause/stop/hide, flash, performance, token, and SSR checks

evals.name: lightweight-motion-routing
evals.prompt: Add a few button press and hover transitions to an otherwise static product.
evals.expected_output: The lightweight path skips dedicated research, but the motion spec records the evidence mode and why the research phase was not warranted.
expectations: Phase 2 is not run for trivial micro-interactions
The spec still includes reduced-motion and accessibility behavior
Implementation proceeds through /develop rather than directly through /motion

evals.name: motion-runtime-qa
evals.prompt: Implement the MO-001 through MO-004 motion prompts from an approved motion handoff.
evals.expected_output: Rex implements the prompts through /develop and QA records motion-specific runtime evidence before certification.
expectations: Every MO-### maps to a prompt, user story, implementation reference, and QA assertion
Timing is checked against the numeric tolerance, defaulting to +/-16ms
Reduced-motion, keyboard/focus, informational fallback, and auto-moving-content controls are tested
Non-essential interaction-triggered animation has a verified disable path unless essential, per WCAG 2.3.3
Only transform and opacity are animated; layout properties, filters, and other animated properties are rejected
Flash thresholds, performance, motion tokens, and SSR/hydration are checked where applicable
Missing motion evidence blocks QA certification
